Automatic Stand feature, 7th level.

Out of your sight, the stand stops sharing damage with you: it has its own Hit Points equal to 5 × your level (damage to it doesn't reach you) and gains +2 to saves. Autonomous: while it runs a Set Program (the Set Program feat), it also gains resistance to all damage equal to twice your level (half that against force, spirit and ghost touch), immunity to mental, fear and death effects and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{stunned}, +3 to hit, Strikes that roll damage dice equal to your level (minimum 8), and it never retreats. When an Autonomous stand is destroyed, it reforms at the start of its own next turn with half its Hit Points. While you're out of its sight you can't Act Together with it, but Feed the Program still works from any distance (your action gives it a second action that turn). Starving the program: if no creature matching its program is within its 60-foot program sense at the start of its turn, it is dormant and does nothing that turn; after 2 dormant turns in a row it unmanifests. The user: if you are knocked out, killed or forced to call it off, it loses these benefits and unmanifests.
